title: Acme Office Supplies - clean invoice
scenario: Happy path: clean PDF, explicit PO, quantities and prices match PO and goods receipt.

title: Greenleaf FM - scanned, no PO number
scenario: Edge case: image-only scan (needs OCR) and no PO reference. The process must infer the PO from vendor, lines and amount.

title: Bluestar IT - 2nd partial invoice on PO-4503
scenario: Edge case: vendor splits one PO across invoices. Invoice 1 (12 units) is already paid; this is invoice 2 (12 more). Cumulative 24 of 30 received.

title: Bluestar IT - 3rd invoice that over-bills PO-4503
scenario: Edge case: 3rd partial invoice for 10 units. After invoices 1+2 (24 units), this takes the PO to 34 of 30 ordered/received.

title: Swift Logistics - re-sent October invoice
scenario: Edge case: invoice SL-7781 was paid last month. Vendor re-sends it as 'SL/7781' with a new layout, so the file hash and the literal number both differ.

title: Swift Logistics - new bank account on invoice
scenario: Edge case: everything matches the PO, but the remit-to bank account differs from the vendor master. Classic invoice-redirection fraud pattern.

title: Acme Office Supplies - toner price above PO
scenario: Extra: toner billed at ₹5,760 against PO price ₹5,600 (+2.9%), outside the 1% tolerance.

title: Orion Packaging - blocked vendor
scenario: Extra: valid-looking invoice and PO, but the vendor is blocked in the vendor master.

title: Acme Office Supplies - no invoice number or date
scenario: Extra: invoice is missing its number and date. Not a valid GST tax invoice, so it must be re-issued.
